goal: Speed up wallet fast rescans by checking compact block filters in parallel across available CPU cores
Greatly reduces wait times for users restoring wallets or scanning large block ranges on multi-core systems
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Verified by testing benchmarks showing up to a 6x rescan speedup (ismaelsadeeq)
Verified by benchmarking on HDD hardware showing a 3x speedup (l0rinc)
Strong concept approval after concerns on threadpool sharing were resolved (rkrux)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because parallel filter checking yields a verified 4.5x to 8x speedup on wallet fast rescans
Significantly cuts wait times when rescanning hundreds of thousands of blocks on multi-core hardware
